package.name: fs_msgs
package.description: FS UART custom ROS 2 message definitions (VehicleStatus, VehicleControl). This is a simulator-local copy of the pedal_node fs_msgs package so the simulator container can build and use these types without needing access to the pedal_node git submodule. Keep in sync with pedal_node/fs_uart_ws/src/fs_msgs.
